data:text/html,<body><canvas id="c"></canvas><div style="margin: 16px;"><span>Interval:</span><span id="interval"></span><div><button style="padding: 16px" onclick="interval += 100" id="plus">+</button><button style="padding: 16px;" onclick="interval -= interval == 0? 0 : 100" id="minus">-</button></div><br/><button style="padding: 24px" onclick="clearTimeout(timeout); setup(); render();" id="reset"> Reset </button><br/><br/><div><span>Keyboard shortcuts</span><ul><li>Arrow Up: increase interval</li><li>Arrow Down: decrease interval</li><li>R: reset</li></ul></div></div><style>body{margin:0;background:black;color:white;display:flex;align-items:center}canvas{display:block}</style><script>let interval=1e3;const W=50,H=50;let game,timeout,SIZE;const c=document.getElementById("c"),ctx=c.getContext("2d");function init(){SIZE=Math.floor(Math.min(window.innerWidth,window.innerHeight)/50),c.width=W*SIZE,c.height=H*SIZE}function setup(){game=Array.from({length:W},()=>Array.from({length:H},()=>Math.random()<.3?1:0))}function count(e,t){let n=0;for(let r=-1;r<=1;r++)for(let i=-1;i<=1;i++)0===r&&0===i||(n+=game[(e+r+W)%25W][(t+i+H)%25H]);return n}function run(){var e=Array.from({length:W},()=>Array(H).fill(0));for(let t=0;t<W;t++)for(let n=0;n<H;n++){let r=count(t,n);game[t][n]?e[t][n]=2==r||3==r?1:0:e[t][n]=3==r?1:0}game=e}function render(){for(let e=0;e<W;e++)for(let t=0;t<H;t++)ctx.fillStyle=game[e][t]?"%230f0":"%23222",ctx.fillRect(e*SIZE,t*SIZE,SIZE-1,SIZE-1);timeout=setTimeout(()=>{run(),render()},interval)}function press(e){"ArrowUp"==e.code?document.getElementById("plus").click():"ArrowDown"==e.code?document.getElementById("minus").click():"KeyR"==e.code&&document.getElementById("reset").click()}init(),setup(),timeout=setTimeout(()=>{run(),render()},interval),setInterval(()=>document.getElementById("interval").innerText=interval,10),window.addEventListener("resize",init),window.addEventListener("keydown",press);</script></body>
